title: rosa rugosa f. plena
intro: Rosa rugosa f. plena, commonly known as Double Japanese Rose or Sea Rose, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Rosa rugosa f. plena are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, particularly rosavin and rosin, are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic effects.
